comment: task recipe-data-b2c-generify - the Generifier static replay. Row sources: (a) the handler walk, RM.Generifier.add(RecipeMapHandlerMaterial) over OreDictMaterial.MATERIAL_ARRAY, Loader_Recipes_Handlers.java:733-735 (condition And(SIMPLIFIABLE, ingotHot.NOT) :731; engine RecipeMapHandlerMaterial.addRecipeForPrefix gregapi/recipes/handlers/RecipeMapHandlerMaterial.java:127-138 - condition gate :128, mAmount<=0 gate, input/output item existence, duration Math.max(1, units(prefix.mAmount, U, 1, roundUp)), eut 0); (b) the RM.generify direct-call sites, grep-enumerated across the upstream tree and replayed per-row with their citation comment below. DECLARED DEVIATION (handler semantics -> JSON static rows): query-time lazy per-material generation frozen to the port universe snapshot (GTMaterialItems.registrationOrder, SIMPLIFIABLE-and-not-ingotHot prefix gate, both-side item existence, mTargetGenerifying != self) - the craftfrom 962-row precedent deviation class. WALK ROW PROVENANCE: the 8690 walk rows carry NO per-row comment (scale ruling of the coordinator: per-row anchors at ten-thousand-row scale are noise) - the per-row provenance IS the GT6RecipeMapDataB2cGenerifyRowsPourTest live-walk cross-check, which recomputes the walk against the live registration and fails the moment this snapshot trails or outruns it. DECLARED OVER-CAP: 8982 rows / ~126k lines, over the 5000-line series soft cap by ruling - the upstream Generifier config is inherently ten-thousand-scale (the handler expands every SIMPLIFIABLE prefix of every material with a generifying target); methodology = live dump -> zero-transcription generation -> live-walk pin, review diffs the dump against the generator instead of counting lines. STATIC ROW SOURCES (per-row cited): vanilla coal/gem brick-ification pairs (Loader_Recipes_Vanilla.java:344-366), dyed fibers -> string (:975-991, all 17 port members), the glowstone identity row (:576 -> RM.java:293), the grass block row (BlockGrass.java:72, wildcard-meta face replayed on the green base id), the stone family rows (BlockStones.java:282-486, one per family form over the SELF-BLOCK subset of the mEqualBlocks walk - other equal-block members are runtime OreDict registrations with no deterministic port replay), and the both-sides-ported fluid rows (Loader_Recipes_Temporary.java:674-708). REPLACED SMOKE ROW: the p29-w1 smoke row (minecraft:sand + minecraft:water -> clay_ball, duration 32 eut 16) carried no upstream generifier semantics and is gone. SKIPPED ROWS (blockers on file): event-listener rows - slimeball listeners (Loader_Recipes_OreDict.java:137-155), egg/tusk/hoof/horn listeners (Loader_Recipes_Food.java:316-334), plant-remains listener (Loader_Recipes_Crops.java:151), dye-dust listeners x16 (Loader_Recipes_Other.java:135-145) - the OreDict event face has no static replay; foreign-identity rows - Compat_Recipes_* trees, Loader_Ores.java:142-176 (UB/EB/PFAA stones), Loader_Rocks.java:153-185 (CHSL/EtFu/GaSu/BOTA granites), the Temporary mud/foreign cycle block (:622-631), the molten-alias block (:634-663, only molten.iron exists port-side and its pair legs are Tinkers spellings), honey -> BoP leg (FL.HoneyBoP), TC knowledge fragments (MultiItemRandomTools.java:465), IC2/TE/RC fluid aliases (steam/redstone/lubricant/reikygen/bioethanol families); port-missing-item rows - clay-ball colors x5 (MultiItemFood.java:130-132, no port identity per the compressor-card precedent), beam/plank/stair/slab rows (Loader_Recipes_Woods.java:190/211/277/295, the IL.Beam/Plank family has no port face), the wildcard-meta book row (MultiItemBooks.java:71, JSON v1 has no damage face); port-missing-fluid rows - water_hot, plant oils (oil_olive/oil_nut/oil_lin/oil_hemp/oil_sunflower, Loader_Recipes_Temporary.java:685-689), canola/plant/soulsand/fuel-oil family (:689-693/:715-722), liquid_methane (:719), potion_poison_2 (:718), for.honeydew (:712), FL.Water_Hot (:679), tar/lava_volcanic (:735/:738). Row census: 8690 walk + 238 stone family + 39 static items (incl. grass) + 15 fluids (incl. 10 waters) = 8982.
